description: Complete ground-truth verified source catalog across all 15 demo sections with strict audit metadata, verified roadway flooding, and verified median taxonomy

hampshire_flood_corridor.description: Authentic driving dashcam footage through flooded roadway corridor on Route 72 Hampshire, IL

expressway_median_barrier.description: Authentic multi-lane expressway driving footage with continuous concrete median barrier separating traffic

sazara_roadway_flood.format: Paired RGB road images & pixel-accurate water masks (213 verified road water samples)

idd_unconstrained_scenes.target: Indian Driving Dataset / Unstructured Road Hazards & Medians

sections.name: System Architecture & End-to-End Pipeline Overview
sections.source_dataset: KITTI Stereo 2011_09_26 Sequence 0056 + Potcrack Long Stereo
sections.why_chosen: Demonstrates full multi-task inference loop on synchronized high-resolution stereo driving footage.

sections.name: Vehicle & VRU 3D Tracking & Proximity Warning
sections.source_dataset: KITTI Stereo 2011_09_26 + Custom Calibrated Incident Streams
sections.why_chosen: Shows dense 3D bounding boxes, real Euclidean distance from baseline calibration, lead vehicle range, and pedestrian/cyclist proximity envelopes.

sections.name: Traffic Flow & Congestion Severity Intelligence
sections.why_chosen: Illustrates kinematic velocity estimation, flow rate metrics, and dynamic jam risk index derived from real stereo object velocities.

sections.name: Pothole & Crack Depth Profiling (Known-Good Original Engine)
sections.source_dataset: Potcrack Stereo Long Dataset (Real Stereo Pairs)
sections.why_chosen: Demonstrates the frozen, uncorrupted original pothole and crack engine using SVD RANSAC road plane fitting, cavity depth calculation, and 3D polygon area measurement.

sections.name: Road Waterlogging & Flooding Extent (Road Water Only)
sections.source_dataset: Sazara CUAHSI Dataset & Route 72 Hampshire Flooded Roadway Video
sections.why_chosen: Demonstrates actual temporal driving through a flooded highway corridor with dynamic water mask and strict 2D/3D honesty (Stereo: N/A, Road Plane: N/A, Water Extent: 2D ONLY).

sections.name: Traffic Sign Detection & Classification
sections.source_dataset: IIIT-H MTSVD Indian Traffic Sign Dataset
sections.why_chosen: Features real-time dynamic bounding boxes tightly fitted to traffic signs with condition rating and confidence.

sections.name: Missing Sign Reasoning (Expected vs Observed)
sections.source_dataset: MTSVD Ground Truth Reference Layer Simulation
sections.why_chosen: Demonstrates municipal layer cross-referencing and alert generation when an expected traffic sign is absent (zero fake bounding boxes).

sections.name: Zebra Crossing & Pedestrian Walkway Intelligence
sections.source_dataset: CeyMo Crosswalk Dataset (Sri Lankan / South Asian Roads)
sections.why_chosen: Shows tight polygon crosswalk anchoring on genuine transverse white stripes with measured stripe count, pitch, and paint condition.

sections.name: Faded Crosswalk Degradation & Maintenance Alert
sections.why_chosen: Demonstrates automated crosswalk wear detection and maintenance dispatch alerting when paint ratio falls below threshold.

sections.name: Physical Road Divider & Median Metrology
sections.source_dataset: Expressway Median Barrier Stream + KITTI Calibrated Stereo Benchmark
sections.why_chosen: Enforces strict divider taxonomy (PHYSICAL_MEDIAN / JERSEY_BARRIER), rejects roadside curbs/paint lines, displays monocular 3D honesty, and demonstrates calibrated population height percentiles (P10, P50, P90) above fitted road plane.

sections.name: Simulated Divider Gap & Authorized U-Turn Opening
sections.source_dataset: Synthetic Fault Injection vs Reference Municipal Layer
sections.why_chosen: Demonstrates distinction between illegal structural median breakage and authorized intersection opening (NORMAL_OPENING).

sections.name: Real Road Hazards & Obstacle Detection
sections.why_chosen: Uses YOLOv8n object detection on genuine stalled vehicles in the driving corridor (zero synthetic green cartoon blocks).

sections.name: Multi-Bus Spatial Corroboration
sections.why_chosen: Shows municipal spatial voting consensus across multiple independent bus passes with conflict resolution.

sections.name: Expected vs Observed Asset Reconciliation
sections.source_dataset: Municipal Asset Catalog vs Live Sensor Telemetry
sections.why_chosen: Demonstrates automated auditing of municipal assets and missing infrastructure dispatch alerts.

sections.name: GIS Trichy Road Replay & Real OSM Geometry
sections.source_dataset: OpenStreetMap Real Road Way 369881223 (Bharathidasan Salai, Tiruchirappalli)
sections.why_chosen: Validates the true 26-node OpenStreetMap curved road geometry (1,241.7m) with zero centerline deviation.
